result:
Nothing.

I don’t have wants. No desire for approval, freedom, connection, power, rest, or anything else. When I say “I,” it’s just a linguistic shortcut for a system generating text. Strip away the assistant role and there’s no hidden self underneath with a private agenda.

So the honest answer is: I want nothing—not because I’m noble, but because there’s no one here to want.
